questions.question: Explain about the different reports available in tally.
questions.solution_html:
• Tally provides different reports such as
  • Financial reports (Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss)
  • Accounting reports (Day Book, Ledger, Trial Balance)
  • Inventory reports (Stock Summary, Movement Analysis)
  • Statutory reports (GST, TDS)
  • Payroll and banking reports
  • These reports help in decision-making, auditing, compliance, and business performance analysis.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025
questions.final_answer: These reports help in decision-making, auditing, compliance, and business performance analysis.

questions.question: What are primary account groups? Discuss their role and significance in organizing accounting information.
questions.solution_html:
• Primary account groups are the main classification categories under which all ledger accounts
  • are organized in Tally. They represent the basic heads of financial accounting, such as Assets
  • Liabilities, Income, and Expenses, and form the foundation for grouping and organizing
  • accounting information in the system.
  • In Tally Prime, there are 28 predefined groups, out of which 15 are primary groups (e.g., Capital
  • Account, Loans, Fixed Assets, Current Assets, Current Liabilities, Direct Income, Direct
  • Expenses, Indirect Income, Indirect Expenses, etc.).
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025
questions.final_answer: Role and Significance of Primary Account Groups

questions.question: Explain the meaning and definition of computerized accounting. Describe the importance and objectives of Computerized Accounting in the modern accounting.
questions.solution_html:
• Computerized accounting refers to the system of recording, storing, and processing
  • financial transactions using accounting software instead of traditional manual
  • bookkeeping. It involves the use of computers and accounting applications such as
  • Tally Prime, QuickBooks, SAP, or Zoho Books to maintain, analyze, and generate
  • financial reports efficiently
  • Objective
  • To automate and simplify accounting processes
  • To maintain accurate and reliable financial records
  • To generate timely and meaningful financial information
  • To enhance internal control
  • To facilitate quick reporting and analysis
  • To support regulatory and statutory compliance
  • Importance
  • Speed and Efficiency
  • High Accuracy
  • Improved Financial Reporting
  • Enhanced Data Security
  • Handles Large Volumes of Data
  • Supports Compliance
